newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions six-month bonds in OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions six-month bonds in OMO.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Thursday it had auctioned six-month maturity short term federal bonds worth a total of 11.12 billion rupees in a special open market operation (OMO).
It said bids worth 11.12 billion rupees were accepted for the outright sale of the six-month bonds at a maximum cut off of 17.45 percent a year.
On Wednesday, the central bank in another OMO had accepted bids worth 775 million rupees for outright sale of the bonds at a maximum cut-off of 17.40 percent.
